description: Terminal live resize in the STRESS session (bench-terminal-resize.py on perf-stress-session.py: 60 workspaces, 4x3 panes and nested splits, 10 busy terminals): the divider between the first two columns dragged one debug.mouse move per display frame, so every terminal of those columns resizes each frame (frame intervals, main-thread busy ms, Ghostty display-pass ms, missed vsyncs, unsettled grids), and Cmd-D, Cmd-W, Cmd-Shift-D, Cmd-W over less (key to the final grid sent, at the owner and drawn).
